capabilities: Search and import artist notes with metadata, genres, images, and Wikipedia summaries
Expand albums and concrete editions into rich release notes with tracklists and cover art
Organize artists into collections, nested bundles, and an Uncollected inbox
Generate Obsidian Bases views for discographies and release editions
Run health checks, rebuild the registry, and repair or delete the generated graph
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Remote metadata requests are rate-limited out of respect for MusicBrainz API policies.
motivation: The author built it because music metadata imports get messy at scale; the plugin keeps a strict structure so the graph stays readable after weeks of real use.
problem: Imported music metadata quickly becomes messy orphan notes in Obsidian, and there is no tool to keep a growing music library structured and connected.

relations.evidence: MusicBrainz for artists, release groups, releases, labels, relationships, and genres.
Cover Art Archive for album and edition artwork.
Wikidata and Wikipedia for linked biographies, summaries, and images.

summary: Music knowledge base builder that imports artists, albums, and release editions from MusicBrainz into linked, structured Obsidian notes.
